# Multiplier Raises $35 Million Series B to Build a New Model for Professional Services

![](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/b2426df10c29495ac023f41b916a59dc8b4c14567730f3a970a0fff566674a16/lightyear_networkapi/resizefit_w960%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fbusiness-wire.com%2Fd2bdef2d5871f1c630d97848f5ad3c96)

_Former Slack CFO Allen Shim joins as President and CFO as Multiplier expands its network of specialized accounting and professional-services firms_

**SINGAPORE, August 04, 2026**--( [BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/))--Multiplier, a technology company that acquires premium professional-services firms and builds AI tools around how those firms work, today announced a $35 million Series B led by The General Partnership, with participation from Ribbit Capital and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

The company also announced that Allen Shim, the former Chief Financial Officer of Slack, has joined Multiplier as President and CFO. Shim helped take Slack public and remained with the company through its acquisition by Salesforce. At Multiplier, he will oversee finance, operations, partnerships, people, and help build out the company's San Francisco office.

Multiplier acquires established professional-services firms with deep expertise in valuable niches and long-standing client relationships. The firms retain their names, leadership, and operating independence, while the professionals responsible for those client relationships share in the value they help create. Multiplier provides what no boutique firm can build alone: long-term capital, shared infrastructure and access to a global network. Its team of more than 30 technologists, recruited from leading software companies, works directly inside the firms to build AI tools around their daily operations.

Multiplier is structured as a permanent holding company rather than a traditional short-term acquisition vehicle. The company focuses on growing firms whose founders want to continue leading their businesses while gaining access to capital, technology, recruiting, operational support, and a broader network of expertise. Unlike companies that sell software to outside firms, Multiplier works directly with the people inside its firms to identify where AI can reduce manual work, expand capacity, and improve client service. Because Multiplier owns the firms where the technology is deployed, its teams have direct access to the workflows, data, professionals, and institutional trust required to build and implement tools around how the work is actually done. This approach addresses many of the adoption barriers that have historically limited software use in professional services.

"An AI's answer is worth zero until a professional puts their name on it," said Noah Pepper, founder and CEO of Multiplier. "We're not trying to remove experts from the work. We're giving firms AI muscle while keeping their human heart, providing them with better tools, more time for judgment, and the capacity to serve more clients without lowering the bar on quality or trust."

Story Continues

Professional-services firms have historically been difficult to scale because their growth depends on the time and availability of experienced practitioners. Many also operate with fragmented information spread across documents, financial statements and email. Recent advances in AI make it possible to automate more of that preparatory and administrative work while keeping professionals responsible for the final advice and client relationship. Multiplier's aim is to expand the number of clients those professionals can serve, rather than reduce the number of professionals required to serve an existing client base.

"Accounting is a large, durable market that has long been constrained by expert capacity," said Anthony Kline, Partner at The General Partnership. "Multiplier is not trying to replace the professionals clients trust. It is building technology into the firms themselves so those professionals can serve more clients, respond faster and spend more time on work that requires judgment. Noah has the operating experience and long-term approach needed to build this model at scale."

Multiplier has acquired eight firms to date, including five in the past year, and has four additional firms under signed term sheets. Its network currently serves clients across more than 10 countries. Founders and leadership teams remain with their firms following an acquisition, and firms within the network have begun referring clients and opportunities to one another.

The new funding will be used to acquire additional firms and expand Multiplier's technology and operating teams.

**About Multiplier**

Multiplier acquires specialized professional-services firms and builds technology around how their experts work. Firms retain their brands, leadership and client relationships while gaining long-term capital, shared infrastructure, operational support and custom AI tools. Multiplier was founded by Noah Pepper, a former Stripe executive who built and led the company's Asia-Pacific business. # Toptal AI Launches, Delivers Frontier-grade AI With Open-weight Models and Full Data Ownership

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- [Toptal](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4816974-1&h=1312786254&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.toptal.com%2F&a=Toptal), recently ranked the #1 Most Reliable Professional Services Company in America by Newsweek, today announced the launch of [Toptal AI](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4816974-1&h=871930455&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.toptal.ai%2F&a=Toptal+AI), a new full-stack AI services company. Toptal AI develops, evaluates, and deploys frontier-grade AI using a combination of open-weight and proprietary models while allowing organizations to retain full ownership and control over their AI systems and data. Launching with more than 200 PhDs in AI-related fields, 100 forward-deployed engineers, and 15 new product lines, Toptal AI serves frontier AI labs, innovative enterprises, and fast-growing startups, acting as the single partner to help organizations realize all of their AI ambitions. Toptal AI encompasses the entire spectrum of AI products, platforms, and services and launches with a curated ecosystem of technology partners, with signed agreements with Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXSI, Gemini, Copilot, Amazon Nova, Databricks, Agentforce, ElevenLabs, Lovable, Miro, Fin, Glean, and Writer.

![Toptal AI](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/65e97c13a592be0e7c91195c87df01b18f2b55bae3beb560370f6cb15b6b666b/lightyear_networkapi/resizefit_w960%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fcnw.ca%2F7410646815fc9dcae3333fb9dddf2e77.jpg)

Toptal AI

Toptal AI's unique AI stack comprises AI strategy, solutions and services, partnerships, talent, platforms, data services, and managed services–everything imaginable in AI. Organizations can develop and fine-tune open-weight, domain-specific models tailored to their data and business; deploy production-ready agents that operate across existing workflows while keeping humans in control; and commercialize their data and AI capabilities to create new revenue streams, all while maintaining full data ownership. Toptal AI also includes a suite of ready-to-deploy outcome agents tailored to specific industries and business contexts.

While Toptal AI is vendor-neutral, it also has its own suite of products and platforms to help companies jump-start their AI journey. AI Workstation serves as the unified control center for connecting and operating any combination of platforms and tools, regardless of provider or vendor. Other Toptal AI platforms include ActionTrace, which captures real work activity across systems and workflows; Operationalize, which fills a critical gap by adding organizational context and establishing a unified business ontology; Maestro, which uses that structured data and context to build and manage models and agents; and RL Refinery, which creates reinforcement learning environments to train models on domain-specific data. This suite of products is a unique recipe for context and model creation that drives enterprise intelligence forward in a repeatable and scalable format.

Story Continues

Toptal AI's three-part methodology ensures that AI development at all phases captures, implements, and scales anything AI can do with precision, consistency, and cost-effectiveness. Toptal AI maintains these systems through a robust MLOps, LLMOps, and managed services offering.

"Toptal AI gives enterprises the ability to deploy frontier-grade AI while maintaining full ownership and control over their costs, systems, data, and infrastructure," said Taso Du Val, founder and CEO of Toptal. "Our unique combination of AI products and experts makes developing AI agents and fine-tuned models possible at a scale that was previously unimaginable."

**About Toptal**

Toptal is the world's largest talent network of highly skilled domain experts, connecting businesses with the top 3% of freelance talent on demand. Toptal was ranked the #1 Most Reliable Professional Services Company in America by Newsweek and Statista, based on an independent survey of more than 2,400 decision-makers at Fortune 500s. Toptal's network includes talent from AI leaders such as OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, and Palantir, as reported by Forbes. Founded in 2010, Toptal has served more than 35,000 clients across more than 140 countries. For more information, please visit [Toptal.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4816974-1&h=1866732138&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.toptal.com%2F&a=Toptal.com).

# Financial Cents Brings Back WorkflowCon for 2026 -- Bigger Than Ever and Still Free













CNW Group



Thu, November 5, 2026 at 12:42 p.m. EST4 min read































_Back by popular demand after a standout 2025, the two-day virtual conference for small and growing accounting firms returns November 9–10 with an expanded lineup: four keynotes, more than 20 speakers across five tracks and the Small & Mighty Awards_



ATLANTA, Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- WorkflowCon is back. [Financial Cents](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4815634-1&h=1764521106&u=https%3A%2F%2Ffinancial-cents.com%2F&a=Financial+Cents), the practice management software built for small and growing accounting and bookkeeping firms, is bringing back its free annual virtual conference — and this year, it's bigger than ever. After a standout 2025, WorkflowCon returns November 9–10, 2026, with an expanded two-day program for firm owners and teams across North America who want to grow with intention. Registration is open now, and attendance is completely free.



This year's theme, "Focus Is the New Flex," reframes what success looks like for small and growing firms. With owners pulled in every direction and pressured to offer more services to more clients, WorkflowCon makes the case for a different approach: deciding what _not_ to do. The program spotlights firm owners who have committed to a single growth lever — a client niche, a service line or a distinct way of working — and held steady everywhere else.



The free, 100% virtual event spans five tracks — Workflow, AI, Client, Revenue and Team — so every member of a firm can find a relevant path. Attendees can join for one day or both, and session recordings are available afterward.



WorkflowCon 2026 features four keynote speakers:



  - Ethan Kross, PhD, psychologist and bestselling author of _Shift_ and _Chatter_, who closes Day 1 with a session on managing emotions under pressure;

  - Keila Hill-Trawick, CPA, founder and CEO of Little Fish Accounting, who delivers the opening plenary;

  - Jan Haugo, founder of SmartAccountant.ai and co-author of Intuit's AI certification; and

  - Nicole Davis, CPA, founder of Conscious Accounting and a Forbes Top 200 CPA.


They are joined by more than 20 firm owners, operators and advisors leading sessions throughout the program.

"WorkflowCon is an opportunity to step away from the day-to-day, learn from other firm owners, and think differently about how you're running your business," said Hill-Trawick.

Highlights from the agenda include candid, practitioner-led sessions such as "Would You Fire This Client?" with Al-Nesha Jones, CPA, and Tony Proctor, EA; "Pricing Is How You Say No" with Logan Graf, CPA; "Attract A-Players in 45 Minutes" with Ryan Lazanis, CPA; "The Minimum Viable Operations Manual" with Justine Lackey; and "Before AI Touches Client Data," a frank look at the questions every tool should answer before being entrusted with sensitive client data. The event opens with a host welcome from Financial Cents CEO Shahram Zarshenas. The full agenda, including Day 2 sessions, will be announced in the coming weeks.

Story Continues

"Running a firm means being pulled in a dozen directions at once, and the pressure to do more of everything never really lets up," said Zarshenas. "WorkflowCon makes the opposite case. The firms we admire most didn't grow by saying yes to everything; they got clear on what mattered and had the discipline to let the rest go. We created these two days so firm owners can step back from the daily grind, learn from peers who've made those calls and leave with a better sense of where to focus."

The event will also crown the winners of the Small & Mighty Awards, which recognize standout accounting, bookkeeping, tax and advisory professionals across the U.S. and Canada in four categories. The four winners — selected from 12 finalists by an independent panel of practitioners — will be revealed live on Day 2.

Registration is free and open now at [workflowcon.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4815634-1&h=984311377&u=https%3A%2F%2Fhubs.li%2FQ04Dsh8y0&a=workflowcon.com).

Firms that want help making the case to a manager can use the conference's ready-made "Convince Your Boss" email template, also available on the site.

**About Financial Cents**

Financial Cents is a leading practice management platform built to help accounting and bookkeeping firms streamline workflows, improve collaboration and scale without chaos. Thousands of firms across North America rely on Financial Cents to manage their work, clients and teams in one place. It is rated 4.8 out of 5 on Capterra and 4.7 out of 5 on G2. Learn more at [financial-cents.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4815634-1&h=1609178897&u=http%3A%2F%2Ffinancial-cents.com%2F&a=financial-cents.com).

# NATIONAL PROFESSIONAL SERVICES FIRM, MNP, EXPANDS PRESENCE IN CENTRAL EASTERN ONTARIO WITH SCARBOROUGH MERGER













CNW Group



Wed, November 4, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. EST3 min read































MNP Welcomes Schwartz & Company Professional Corporation, Building on Commitment to Support the Central Eastern Ontario Market



CALGARY, AB, Nov. 4, 2026 /CNW/ -- MNP, one of Canada's largest national professional services firms, is pleased to announce that it will join forces with the chartered professional accounting firm, Schwartz & Company Professional Corporation, effective December 1st, 2026.



Based in the GTA, the firm is led by Vince Chiofalo and Gus Yantsis who will join MNP as partners.



Schwartz & Company primarily serves SMBs in the GTA. Their practice is deeply rooted in the local business community, working with a diverse client base that includes physicians, manufacturing, distribution, retail, real estate and construction, family offices and entrepreneurs. The firm offers a full range of accounting, assurance, and tax services.



Niko Anastassakis, CPA, CA, MNP's Regional Managing Partner for Central Eastern Ontario, said the merger reflects MNP's continued commitment to investing in strong local relationships and enhancing the value delivered to clients across the region.



"We are excited to welcome Schwartz & Company to MNP. One of the things that stands out most about the firm is the strength of the relationships they have built with their clients and within the broader business community. By joining forces, we are bringing together a highly connected network of businesses and organizations with MNP's expanded capabilities and resources."



Schwartz & Company Partner, Gus Yantsis CPA, CA, says the merger strengthens his team's ability to support their clients:



"Throughout our history, our priority has always been building lasting relationships and helping our clients succeed. As our clients' needs continue to evolve, we wanted to align with a firm that shares our values and commitment to personalized service. Joining MNP allows us to maintain the close relationships our clients value while providing them with access to a broader range of expertise, resources, and opportunities to support their long-term goals."



Founded in 1958, MNP has grown to more than 150 locations across Canada and delivers a wide range of services and specialized expertise in every sector and area of business. In addition to tax and accounting, MNP offers a diverse range of consulting and advisory services, including succession planning, estate planning, enterprise risk, corporate finance, valuation and litigation support, insolvency and restructuring, digital strategies, cross-border taxation, and much more.





Story Continues





MNP has invested in Central Eastern Ontario in recent years, adding Peterborough, Lindsay and Port Hope locations to its existing long standing Oshawa office. The region now includes over 105 team members, including 20 partners.



"We are thrilled to welcome the Schwartz & Company partners and their team to MNP." added Jared Bourne, Executive Vice President, Ontario outside GTA at MNP. "Schwartz & Company has built a strong reputation founded on trusted client relationships and exceptional service. Their values, entrepreneurial spirit, and commitment to helping local businesses succeed align closely with MNP's culture. This merger strengthens our presence in Central Eastern Ontario, while expanding our ability to support clients with the combination of local insight, personalized service, and the national resources of MNP."



The Schwartz & Company team will move into MNP's Oshawa office as of the effective date.



**About MNP LLP**

National in scope and local in focus, MNP is one of Canada's leading professional services firms — proudly serving individuals, businesses, and organizations since 1958. Through the development of strong relationships, we provide client-focused accounting, consulting, tax, and digital services. Our clients benefit from personalized strategies with a local perspective to fuel success wherever business takes them. # Financial Cents Launches MCP Server to Put Firm Data to Work Inside Everyday AI Assistants













CNW Group



October 20, 20264 min read































_New Model Context Protocol server lets accounting, bookkeeping and tax firms ask questions and take action on their Financial Cents data from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI tools — scoped to one account, authorized by the firm and revocable anytime._



ATLANTA, Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- [Financial Cents](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4799344-1&h=1796019358&u=https%3A%2F%2Ffinancial-cents.com%2F&a=Financial+Cents), a leading accounting practice management software, today announced the launch of the Financial Cents MCP, a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects a firm's Financial Cents account to the AI assistants it already uses, including Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini. Once connected, firms can ask plain-English questions about their work — like "What's overdue this week?" or "Which invoices are still unpaid?" — and have their assistant take action, from logging time to creating tasks, without copying data out of their practice management system.





![FC Logo](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/4f77e49dd9ca24df5e43d2338f2402505bca6b79026db18d6f9c7825e6c112cb/lightyear_networkapi/resizefit_w960%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fcnw.ca%2F58331b19c575ab2daac12ca6057f4641.jpg)



FC Logo

The launch comes as firms are adopting AI faster than they can connect it to their actual work. In Financial Cents' recent [State of AI in Bookkeeping & Accounting: 2026 Report](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4799344-1&h=289211834&u=https%3A%2F%2Ffinancial-cents.com%2Fresources%2Fguides%2Fthe-state-of-ai-in-bookkeeping-accounting%2F&a=State+of+AI+in+Bookkeeping+%26+Accounting%3A+2026+Report) — based on a survey of nearly 500 accounting and bookkeeping professionals across North America — 95% said they already use AI in some capacity, yet only about one in five could point to a clear, measurable return. Part of the reason is structural: a firm's real data lives inside its practice management software, separate from the chat window where their AI runs, so getting value has required constant copy-pasting and tab-switching.



The Financial Cents MCP closes that gap. A firm connects its account once and lets its assistant read and update its Financial Cents data directly (within the firm's set permission levels), turning the status checks, time logging and client follow-ups that eat up the day into simple, plain-English requests.



"Firms don't need another place to work — they need their work to show up where they already are," said Shahram Zarshenas, CEO of Financial Cents. "Your clients, deadlines and numbers shouldn't be trapped in one more tab you have to open. With the MCP, you just ask, in plain language, and the answer comes from your own real data. And because this tool runs on your existing permissions and confirms with you before changing anything, you still stay in control of every decision."



_How Firms Use the MCP_



A bookkeeper can check this month's close across clients or spin up a client's recurring tasks; a tax preparer can find who still hasn't uploaded documents and assign the follow-ups; a firm owner can see what's overdue, who owns it or what's outstanding in unpaid invoices — in seconds, and within their own permissions.





Story Continues





_Control and Security Built In_



Control and security are part of how the connection works. Authentication uses OAuth 2.1, so no password or API key is ever shared with the AI client, and each connection is bound to a single firm account. The assistant confirms before it makes any changes, every action is audited and rate limited, and access can be revoked in one click. Deletes are intentionally not available over the MCP at all, and the connection runs inside Financial Cents, which is [SOC 2 certified](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4799344-1&h=860768304&u=https%3A%2F%2Ffinancial-cents.com%2Fsecurity&a=SOC+2+certified) and encrypts data in transit and at rest.



The MCP is the latest in a series of releases meant to give small firms a practical path into AI. In recent months, Financial Cents has launched [three free AI agents](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4799344-1&h=2429100564&u=https%3A%2F%2Ffinancial-cents.com%2Fartificial-intelligence%2F&a=three+free+AI+agents) (AI File Renamer, AI File Validator and AI File Router) for repetitive document work, published its State of AI report and released an [AI edition of Two Cents Magazine](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4799344-1&h=2917689945&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmagazine.financial-cents.com%2Fissue%2Fissue-02-artificial-intelligence%2F&a=AI+edition+of+Two+Cents+Magazine). The through-line is AI that fits the way firms already work, rather than asking them to adopt a new system.



"The firms getting the most out of AI right now aren't those with the biggest tech stack, but those who kept it simple and stayed in control," Zarshenas added. "Our job is to meet firms where they are. The MCP brings their real data into the tools they've already chosen, on their terms, so the technology handles the busywork and the human experts keep the judgment."



The Financial Cents MCP is available now on the Scale plan. Firms can connect their assistant in minutes with a single server URL and standard sign-in — no developer setup — by following the [setup guide](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4799344-1&h=1845553257&u=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.financial-cents.com%2Fmcp-guide&a=setup+guide). Firms new to Financial Cents can [start a 14-day free trial](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4799344-1&h=3044661424&u=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.financial-cents.com%2Fregister%2F&a=start+a+14-day+free+trial). Learn more at [financial-cents.com/mcp](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4799344-1&h=1765744285&u=https%3A%2F%2Ffinancial-cents.com%2Fmcp%2F&a=financial-cents.com%2Fmcp).

# Flinks launches Professional Services and Managed Services to build and run new financial capabilities













CNW Group



October 15, 20263 min read































_Flinks teams will deliver capabilities like account switching, investment transfers, and payroll switching on the bank connectivity, financial data intelligence, and money movement infrastructure Flinks already runs_



TORONTO, Oct. 15, 2026 /CNW/ -- Flinks, the embedded finance platform, today launched two new offerings for financial institutions and fintechs. Professional Services builds new financial capabilities alongside a client's team, and Managed Services runs the infrastructure and operations behind those capabilities once they are live.





![Flinks launches Professional Services and Managed Services as part of its Enterprise Solutions.](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/d5486b98d9ccefce66fbd772eff2f99a02586bd885384047107c80dbde8c7a16/lightyear_networkapi/resizefit_w960%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fcnw.ca%2F7316aa8e24de6988e5b0f9236500c040.jpg)



Flinks launches Professional Services and Managed Services as part of its Enterprise Solutions.

Many financial institutions already have the APIs to offer new services to their customers and partners. Deciding what to build on top of them, and how to turn it into revenue, is harder. Internal builds compete with roadmaps set well in advance, and every launched capability becomes another system internal teams must maintain. Flinks takes on that gap with these two offerings.



**Professional Services** follows three stages: Scope, Build, and Manage. Flinks starts with the client's goals and use case, and its consulting team can help identify opportunities when a use case isn't yet defined. Dedicated Flinks squads then handle architecture and delivery, building in security and regulatory requirements from the start. A few examples of what Flinks can build include account switching, investment transfers, payroll switching, white-label credit underwriting, and distribution through third-party apps. If it connects accounts, makes financial data useful, or moves money, Flinks can build it with you.



**Managed Services** covers the infrastructure and operations financial institutions need to run financial capabilities over time: partner onboarding, accreditation, consent management, governance, service-level commitments, and support, along with the read and write APIs underneath. For institutions that share data with third parties, one connection to Flinks replaces managing dozens of data-recipient relationships directly. Flinks' open banking infrastructure, previously offered as Flinks Outbound, is now part of Managed Services.



The two offerings are designed to work together. A capability built through Professional Services can move directly into Managed Services at launch, operated by the same team that built it.



"Canadian institutions are sitting on infrastructure that can power a new generation of financial services, and the ones that act now will define what banking looks like here," said Julien Cousineau, Founder & CEO, Flinks. "Speed to market is what counts. Professional Services and Managed Services give institutions a partner that builds alongside their teams and keeps running what we build together, so new capabilities reach customers sooner."





Story Continues





"Our clients kept bringing us ideas that weren't on anyone's roadmap, including ours," said Eddie Beqaj, Chief Revenue Officer, Flinks. "Now we can build that with you, and we'll be there to run it after it launches."
